description:
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Grim Poppet until your next turn.
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Volrath.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Volrath by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 2.
